subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "Please give me your English Grammar And Composition Book," said Sara. "I cannot give it," said Niha. "I have to take it with me in the class." "I shall return the book before the class starts," said Sara. "Take it," said Niha. "Thank you," said Sara.
guide_solution: Sara courteously requested Niha to give her (S) her (N) English Grammar and Composition Book. Niha replied that she (N) could not give it. She added that she (N) had to take it with her (N) in the class. Then Sara assured her (N) that she (S) would return the book before the class started. Hearing this, Niha allowed her (S) to take it. Then Sara thanked her (N).
